item.title: $5.35M grant helps fund AI workshop, new broadband at FAMU
item.description: Along with the workshop, the grant is helping FAMU achieve the fastest broadband speeds among HBCUs at 100 gigabits per second.

item.title: Gulf Specimen Marine Lab helping almost 50 cold-stunned sea turtles
item.description: As temperatures drop even lower this weekend, the Gulf Specimen Marine Lab is working to rehab hundreds of cold-stunned sea turtles to come into their facility.

item.title: Florida lawmakers push to ban retail nitrous oxide sales
item.description: State leaders and law enforcement officials cite growing concerns over misuse and public safety. The bill aims to restrict access and increase oversight.
